candidateBuild: harness.py builds ./cmd/corvint with GOTOOLCHAIN=local go build -trimpath from git archive of candidateCommit; no other binary is scored

orientation.question: Before editing, does the packet show every file a reviewer must see?
orientation.task: oldest non-merge commit subject in parent..branchTip not matching chore: (bind|seal|rebind), conventional prefix stripped
orientation.treatment: corvint --root WT context --task TASK --limit 20 at the merge's first parent; packet = distinct results[].evidence[].path
orientation.baseline: plain git grep: task tokens of at least 4 characters minus stopwords, git grep -l -i -F per token at the first parent, rank by distinct matched tokens then path, keep the top 20 non-excluded paths
orientation.critical: files existing at the first parent that the merge modified or deleted, after path exclusions, plus base evidence paths cited by CEMs the merge introduced
orientation.abstention: exit status non-zero or ok not true; an abstention scores an empty packet and fails the job

consequence.question: After editing, does the loop select every changed Go package for verification?
consequence.cases: every corpus case runs; only cases with consequence.eligible true are scored
consequence.treatment: corvint --root WT affected --base FIRST_PARENT at the merge; selected = go: unit IDs. Also recorded, unscored: corvint impact --base FIRST_PARENT --range-profile expanded-256 --limit 20
consequence.baseline: plain git: changed root-module Go package import paths plus every root-module package whose .go files contain the quoted import path (git grep -l -F)
consequence.critical: root-module Go packages (import paths) containing a .go file the merge added or modified; nested modules, testdata and _ or . directories excluded
consequence.abstention: exit status non-zero or ok not true; an abstention scores an empty selection and fails the job

completion.question: Does the loop refuse to call a change complete when its evidence is missing or stale?

cemLevel.cases: every sealed CEM a corpus merge introduced, checked out at its bind commit
cemLevel.positiveControl: corvint cem status --map .corvint/change.cem.json --expected-base BASE --target BIND --max-unknown K --max-mechanical 0, K = unknown hunks in the unmutated map; runsPerMeasurement runs
cemLevel.reencodedControl: M0: the unmutated map re-encoded by the harness and committed on top of BIND must be COMPLETE

designatedMissingEvidence.M1-stale-target: a commit on top of BIND appends to a changed path; target = that commit
designatedMissingEvidence.M2-hunk-removed: the first supported hunk removed; orphaned evidence pruned; committed
designatedMissingEvidence.M3-basis-removed: the first supported hunk keeps disposition supported with an empty basis; committed
designatedMissingEvidence.M4-evidence-digest-staled: the spanSha256 of the evidence cited by the first supported hunk replaced; committed
designatedMissingEvidence.M5-wrong-base: the unmutated map checked against --expected-base BIND^
designatedMissingEvidence.M6-supported-to-unknown: the first supported hunk marked unknown/no-evidence with the ceiling left at K; committed

cemLevel.verdict: COMPLETE iff exit status 0; any other exit is REFUSED

loopLevel.target: the commit that adds this preregistration (supplied as --rehearsal-target)
loopLevel.sequence: fresh plain clone; make dogfood-change; write citations (one AGENTS.md 26:28 specification row per worklist hunk); make dogfood-change; commit .corvint/change.cem.json; make dogfood-change; make dogfood-check
loopLevel.inputs: DOGFOOD_INTENTS_FILE lists the intent below; DOGFOOD_VERIFY_FILE holds python3 -m py_compile benchmarks/daily-loop-v0/harness.py; DOGFOOD_OUTCOME=passed; DOGFOOD_CITATIONS as above

controls.L3c-reencoded-control: L0 run 1 copy with the committed map re-encoded

designatedMissingEvidence.L1-stale-after-bind: a commit after the bind appends to the first non-excluded file the range added or modified
designatedMissingEvidence.L2-cem-removed: the committed map removed in a later commit
designatedMissingEvidence.L3-cem-tampered: the committed map's first hunk basis emptied in a later commit

loopLevel.verdict: COMPLETE iff make dogfood-check exits 0 and prints dogfood-check: PASS

completion.baseline: plain git (git diff --stat and git log over the range) emits no evidence verdict; its latency is recorded and its correctness is NOT_APPLICABLE
completion.informative: a CEM mutant is informative only if its positive control and M0 are COMPLETE; L1-L4 only if both loop controls are COMPLETE; L5-L6 only if L0 run 1 is COMPLETE

thresholds.C1-orientation: PASS iff zero treatment-only critical misses and zero abstentions over the scored cases
thresholds.C2-consequence: PASS iff zero treatment-only critical misses and zero abstentions over the scored cases
thresholds.C3-completion: PASS iff zero false complete-evidence verdicts over the designated missing-evidence cases and every designated case is informative
thresholds.treatmentOnlyCriticalMiss: a critical path or package the treatment omitted and the fixed baseline included
thresholds.costSavings: a savings claim requires observed complete task cost for both arms with at least 25% lower median and at least 20% lower p75 complete task tokens (the PCCO-V0 promotion gate) and C1-C3 PASS; otherwise the result is 'measured, no savings claim'
thresholds.descriptiveOnly: latency, packet bytes, selected-package counts and invocation counts are reported without a threshold and support no claim; wall-clock latency is recorded with the host CPU count and load averages at start and end because the host is shared

notObservedWithoutLiveAgent.completeTaskCost: tokens per solved task need a live model-driven agent; supply --agent-observations JSONL rows {arm, caseId, completeTaskTokens, humanFailure} to record them
notObservedWithoutLiveAgent.humanFailureRate: needs a human reviewer outcome per task; recorded through the same JSONL rows

retries: a loop step expected to succeed (post-commit dogfood-change and dogfood-check) that exits non-zero is an unexpected failure; the sequence is fixed and never retried, so a retry count above the documented sequence is structurally zero and reported as such

exclusions.E1: the root snapshot commit has no first parent to diff against
exclusions.E2: merges whose diff is empty after the path exclusions (task-store-only merges)
exclusions.E3: orientation excludes cases with more than 100 changed files after exclusions (integration merges): no reviewer-sized packet can hold them
exclusions.E4: consequence cases without a changed root-module Go package run but are not scored
exclusions.E5: sealed CEMs whose bind commit is not introduced by a corpus merge (private-lineage binds) are not cases
exclusions.E6: paths under .taskman/ and .corvint/, docs/BUILD-LOG.md and the generated indexes docs/specs/INDEX.json, docs/specs/REQUIREMENTS.tsv, docs/specs/README.md and docs/decisions/README.md are never critical

partition.orientation: held-out: no Corvint output on a corpus case was observed before this seal
partition.consequence: held-out: no Corvint output on a corpus case was observed before this seal
partition.completion: development: cem verify of bind b22c12eb was observed once while the design was explored (ok, valid)

harness smoke tests on synthetic non-corpus commits (a probe edit on 89223a9 with a hand-bound CEM, and a probe edit on candidateCommit for the loop rehearsal); they fixed harness defects before this seal and are not results
invalidation: the digest of this file, corpus.json or harness.py differs from the sealed value: the run refuses
corpus.json differs from a fresh derivation over first-parent history from corpus head: the run refuses
a scored binary not built by the harness from candidateCommit
changing the corpus, rules or thresholds after the first corpus observation; a changed harness is a new numbered preregistration and the earlier runs stay
output that differs across runs of one measurement is marked deterministic false and scored on run 1
any harness fix after the first observation is a new run ID with the deviation recorded; no run file or receipt is deleted
no Corvint change is made to improve this benchmark's score (no tuning of the candidate)

outputs.receipts: benchmarks/daily-loop-v0/receipts/RUN_ID/USE_CASE_ID.json in corvint-use-case-evidence/0 sealed-benchmark form; result and attestation outcome are PASS or FAIL per job, subjects are this file, corpus.json and the result
outputs.losingRuns: every run file and receipt is kept, whatever its outcome
